name: Gonadorelin
description: Synthetic copy of GnRH (LHRH), the 10-amino-acid peptide hormone made by the hypothalamus

status.humanEvidence: FDA approved (1982); small studies in men

note.text: No published human study of gonadorelin given with testosterone therapy was found. No US product is labelled for that use; it is off-label.

bullets: **Same sequence** as the body’s own GnRH
**Induces release** of endogenous LH from the pituitary (label)
**LH and FSH** drive testosterone and sperm production in the testes
**Given in pulses** by pump in men who lack their own GnRH
Pump studies in 22 to 28 men, not randomized

practical.routes: Under the skin by pulsed pump in studies; injection, nasal (EU)
practical.soldAs: No US human product; compounding (503B) under FDA review
practical.monitored: Sperm, testis volume, hormones, bone density

regulatory.text: Prohibited at all times in males (S2)

references: FDA, Drugs@FDA record for Factrel (NDA 018123), accessed Nov 2026
Am J Mens Health, gonadorelin pump vs hCG/hMG in hypogonadism, Jan 2019
